Lina Gomez: Quick thoughtwe should formalize a 7/30/90 remediation card we can attach to postmortems. minimal fields.
Lina Gomez: sketch: Owner / Backup / Priority / ETA(7/30/90) / Verification steps / Rollback / Observability changes / Recurrence tag / Status
Rohit Malhotra: +1. add Owner SLA (48h ack) and a "blocked-by" field for infra/eng dependencies.
Evelyn Park: For verification add a short test matrix: smoke, perf, canary. also include who verifies (owner vs QA).
Connor Wu: Comms cadence thought: internal incident digest weekly, follow-up note to impacted product teams within 48h, public status update within 72h for customer-facing outages.
Lina Gomez: What about recurring incidents detection? we should flag incidents with the same RCA tag and trigger an escalation after 3 occurrences in 90 days.
Rohit Malhotra: I can write a tracker query to tag repeats and surface a "recurrence radar" in the oncall dashboard.
Evelyn Park: IC rotation: prefer 4-week slots with a 3-day overlap for handoffs. handoff checklist = access, active runbooks, current remediations, critical triage notes.
Connor Wu: Let's add a short pairing session on day 1 of overlap to walk through a hot incident runbook.
Lina Gomez: volunteers? Rohit for recurrence script, Evelyn for verification checklist, Connor for comms templates. I'll consolidate into a single playbook doc.
ops-bot: Created doc: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/remediation-card-v0 (edit: eng-oncall)
Rohit Malhotra: i'll prototype the recurrence query by end of week.
Evelyn Park: i'll drop a verification checklist skeleton in the doc by Thu.
Connor Wu: will draft concise email/status templates. aim for copy-ready snippets.
Lina Gomez: great. once we have the card and small automation we can pilot for next postmortem cycle. thanks all :thumbsup:
